summary: Built one relocatable generator preserving independent 2×2 entry lookup in easy, moderate and hard. All nine requested delivery survivors passed; 32 valid/30 wrong native controls, 36 UI presentations, 4/4 source replays and durable refill checks passed.
limitations: Moderate/hard labels are authored and uncalibrated; progression changes integer reading, not the lookup method.
Captured-basis offline delivery does not test live learner history/weights or publication; independent final verifier review belongs to runner.
Shared refill report emits inaccurate catalog-exhaustion wording despite exhausted=false and three valid survivors; documented for parent without modifying forbidden shared code.
